slides.texte_overlay:
How to get your confidence
back after a breakup
Give yourself a few rough days, then a plan. Feeling bad is normal. But set a date, like next Monday, when you start rebuilding. Sadness needs time, not your whole year.
Stop checking her profile. Mute, archive, whatever it takes. Every look restarts the pain. You can't heal while you keep refreshing the thing that hurts you.
Move your body every single day. A run, the gym, a long walk. Exercise is the fastest way to calm a racing mind, and seeing your body change rebuilds confidence fast.
Reconnect with the friends you neglected. Call them, apologise if you disappeared, make plans. The people who were there before the relationship are your best support now.
Before: replaying the same memories every night. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a mind busy with new ideas instead of old conversations.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: replaying the same memories every night. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. My mind is busy with new ideas.

slides.texte_overlay: Learn what you'd do differently, without blaming her. Write it down honestly. Taking real lessons from a breakup is how you become a better partner next time.
Do one thing you postponed for the relationship. The trip, the course, the new hobby. Remembering who you are on your own is the real confidence comeback, and it lasts.
